newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN RAND WILTS, BONDS SURGE AHEAD OF PPI.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN RAND WILTS, BONDS SURGE AHEAD OF PPI.

text.p: The South African rand opened Tuesday's proceedings out of favour as players toasted the greenback's strong start to the week.
"The dollar went up and the rand is losing accordingly. I think the market also was a a bit short this morning as it went up, but its quiet. Nothing major is happening," said one forex dealer.
The dollar was last at 1.8623/28 marks, having jumped on the Buba's decision to leave repo tender rate unchanged.
The local unit was last changing hands at 4.6750/6780 to the dollar from Monday's late price of 4.6665/6695.
Dealers expected the rand to remain rangebound between 4.6550 and 4.6800.
In early cross rate action the rand was last quoted at 0.3987/3992 on the weakened mark from 0.3979/3983 Monday and at 24.8118/8491 yen from 24.9026/9293.
Against sterling, the rand last traded at 7.3918/3012 from Monday's late level of 7.4175/4269.
